lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: An array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns and three horizontal rows, located posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the centers of the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single linear feature running horizontally along the superior lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high (dorsal) to low (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete clusters of high-intensity pixels distributed across the first dorsal fin macro-mask, primarily visible on the lower and middle segments.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense cluster of small high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary blobs observed on the lateral flank.
